question.question: For each Eyrie leader give the Vizier columns and special ability.

expected.expected_answer: Builder Recruit/Move ignore Disdain; Charismatic Recruit/Battle must recruit two; Commander Move/Battle extra attacker hit; Despot Move/Build one extra VP when removing at least one enemy building/token in battle.

source_passages.quotation:
| Leader | Vizier columns | Ability |
|---|---|---|
| Builder | Recruit, Move | Ignore Disdain for Trade |
| Charismatic | Recruit, Battle | Each Recruit must place two warriors instead of one |
| Commander | Move, Battle | One extra hit as attacker |
| Despot | Move, Build | When removing at least one enemy building/token in battle, score one extra VP in addition to normal removal points |

answer.ruling: Builder has Viziers in Recruit and Move and ignores Disdain for Trade.
Charismatic has Viziers in Recruit and Battle; each Recruit must place two warriors instead of one.
Commander has Viziers in Move and Battle and gets one extra hit as attacker.
Despot has Viziers in Move and Build; when removing at least one enemy building or token in battle, score one extra VP in addition to normal removal points.
